claimsNote: Every flag is literally false. Nothing in this repository implements this contract: no runtime evaluates a rubric, retains a ballot, computes a panel census, verifies a citation or bounds a reflection. Flipping any flag to true must be a deliberate, reviewed edit made by the lane that implements the corresponding behavior, never an inference from this corpus.

provenance.note: Every expectation here is derived only from verification-semantics.md, the five schemas it names, and integrated-barrier-semantics.md for the composition assertions. No value is copied from another conformance fixture and no value is imported from a language runtime.

composesWith.note: Stage 2 is bit-identical to the barrier's satisfaction arithmetic and every panel census projects to a document the frozen barrier decision schema accepts. Stage 1 is a strictly earlier gate the barrier does not have, and its only outputs are unknown and human.
